evals.name: readme-and-error-rewrite
evals.prompt: Rewrite the README and the API error messages so a new developer can actually run the app and fix failures.
evals.expected_output: Leads with what the app is and who it is for, adds runnable prerequisites and configuration, removes fake claims, and rewrites errors with cause and next action.
assertions: Leads with what the app is and who it is for
Adds runnable prerequisites, setup steps, and configuration
Removes or flags fake claims and testimonials
Rewrites errors to say what happened, why, and what to do
Keeps the text concise and specific
